guide.title: AI Assistant & Ollama Guide
guide.howToUseTitle: 🧑‍💻 How to Use the Neural Network (AI Assistant)
guide.howToUseStep1: Open the AI Assistant (chat icon or 'AI Assistant' drawer).
guide.howToUseStep3: Akira will respond using the selected LLM model, trigger animation and voice.
guide.howToUseStep4: Change language in settings for multilingual answers.
guide.howToUseStep5: Enable/disable audio output in the chat footer.
guide.noteText: For the AI Assistant to work, you must have a local Ollama server running with a compatible LLM model installed (see below).
guide.ollamaTitle: 🤖 How to Install and Use Ollama
guide.ollamaStep1: Go to https://ollama.com/download and install for your OS.
guide.ollamaStep2: Run ollama serve (or launch from Start menu on Windows).
guide.ollamaStep3: Pull a model: ollama pull llama3 (or another from Ollama Library).
guide.ollamaStep4: In Akira, open Settings → Ollama Host, set to http://localhost:11434 (default), and select your model.
guide.ollamaStep5: Open the AI Assistant and start chatting!
guide.troubleshooting1: If you see errors like 'Failed to connect to Ollama' or 'No models found':
guide.troubleshooting2: Make sure Ollama is running and accessible at the configured host.
guide.troubleshooting3: Ensure you have pulled at least one model (e.g., ollama pull llama3).
guide.troubleshooting4: Check firewall/antivirus settings if running on Windows.
guide.moreHelp: For more help, see the Ollama documentation or open an issue in this repository.
